description: Residual gen-verilog yosys smoke failures tracked in issue #1245. Wave Loop 455 cleared the tuple-return, let-destructuring, and ROM/function-local-array lowering gaps. Wave Loop 491 added a documented adversarial witness (nested struct-literal field initialized from a struct-typed parameter) that the current Verilog emitter lowers to malformed syntax. Wave Loop 492 adds an Icarus-only adversarial witness (nested struct-return field access) that is syntactically accepted by yosys but rejected by Icarus simulation and the lowerability predicate.
